The '''Ciutric Planetary Security Forces''' were the [[Planetary Security Forces|security force]] of the [[Ciutric Hegemony]] during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. Upon the [[Declaration of a New Order]], the Ciutric Planetary Security Forces were integrated in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. Veterans of the Ciutric Planetary Security Forces later formed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Axxila antipirate fleet]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
